release_notes: Added a two-frame runner with gravity-flip orientation, jet trails, chroma tinting, afterimages, and a visible compact hit core.

Added deterministic Shift Break rules, effects, scoring, telemetry, tutorials, and tests. Matching bullets outside the break radius remain dangerous; off-color phasing and matching auto-fire are unchanged.
Reduced the projectile collision core while preserving a generous graze radius and the three-life model.
`npm test` passed all orchestrator, game-logic, and live-scene tests. `npm run build:game` also passed and produced the Web export.
The browser smoke harness could not bind its loopback server due to sandbox restrictions; the exported artifacts and scene tests validated successfully.
Runner asset: [runner_sheet.png](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/assets/chroma/runner_sheet.png). Generated with the built-in image-generation tool, then chroma-keyed and despilled locally.

Final image prompt: “Create a polished two-frame 2D side-scrolling mobile-game sprite sheet of one consistent human runner in an ivory and charcoal futuristic jumpsuit, opaque helmet, and compact backpack jets; side profile facing right, opposite running poses, crisp premium arcade silhouette, matching Chroma Drift’s dark neon industrial style, on a flat #00ff00 chroma-key background; no weapons, ship parts, text, shadows, logos, or cropped limbs.”
